system.description:
You weave summoning seals together and infuse them with medical release chakra and a portion of your spirit, manifesting a summoning tag that you throw into a point you can see within range. From the chakra seal an echoing call of shadowy figures of your choice begin to manifest filling a 20-foot radius, which counts as difficult terrain. The creatures resemble once living entities you knew. Whenever a creature starts its turn in this jutsu’s radius or enters it for the first time on its turn, the conjured shadows all strike.

Affected creatures make a Strength saving throw, taking 2d12 necrotic damage and dragging them 5 feet towards the center of the radius. Creature who begin their turns within the radius of this jutsu have their speed reduced by half until the beginning of their following turn

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 chakra and the size of the cube by 5 feet and the damage by 1d12.
